t2.thesis: Despite major contracted AI backlog announcements, TeraWulf's inability to rally on its Google credit backstop news combined with sector-wide pressure on AI hosting economics and a track record of earnings-day drops tilts the odds below baseline.
reasons: TeraWulf's prior 4 earnings reactions have a 25% win rate, averaging negative price reactions on print mornings.
The stock fell 4% on November 4 despite announcing a landmark Google backstop for its Anthropic lease, demonstrating heavy institutional selling pressure and exhaustion of positive headline momentum.
Sector-wide sentiment for AI miners/hosting providers is severely deteriorating following political headwinds and valuation resets (KBW cuts, peers CIFR down 17%, IREN down 9%).
EPS revisions have worsened by 150% over the last 90 days from -0.15 to -0.375, setting up a likely wider operating loss print.
t2.deciding_variable: Q3 EBITDA burn and updated cash/debt financing timeline for the Justified and Lake Mariner builds prior to tenant rent commencement.

prior.from: D004 base rates table: BMO earnings session hit rate (0.548 across 898 events)

t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down by 7.8 percentage points from the 0.548 BMO baseline due to failure to hold gains on blockbuster news, poor earnings track record (25% win rate), negative EPS revisions, and broad AI compute hosting sector de-rating.

theses.expected: Weak print with widening operating losses triggers continuation of the sector selloff
theses.mechanism: HPC capital expenditures and overhead compress margins while lease revenues remain staged for late 2027/2028, disappointing momentum traders.
theses.wrong_if: High short interest (30.2% of float) sparks an aggressive short squeeze if management provides accelerated delivery timelines or non-dilutive debt financing terms.

theses.expected: Sell-the-news exhaustion after recent major announcements
theses.mechanism: With Google backstop and Fluor EPC agreements already disclosed on Nov 4, the earnings release contains little new positive fundamental catalysts.
theses.wrong_if: Management announces another surprise multi-gigawatt hyperscaler contract during the conference call.

theses.expected: Market punishes high cash burn in a risk-off tape for power-infrastructure plays
theses.mechanism: Rising skepticism about infrastructure funding math across the sector keeps multiples compressed heading into the weekend.
theses.wrong_if: Broader crypto/bitcoin strength lifts all mining-adjacent assets regardless of idiosyncratic fundamentals.

key_observations: Q3 2026 revenue vs $44.8M in Q2 and EPS vs -$0.375 consensus
Updates on CB-4 commissioning at Lake Mariner and initial rent commencement timing
Project debt financing status for Justified campus following Google credit backstop
Short interest dynamics and pre-market volume relative to 20-day average
